content: subosito/flutter-action@v2 (2.23.0) is the standard GitHub Action for Flutter on CI; windows-latest runner + 'flutter build windows'; pin via flutter-version or flutter-version-file (pubspec environment needs exact flutter: 3.50.0). Linux build needs ninja-build libgtk-3-dev (+ libx11-dev libxi-dev for leanflutter plugins). MSIX optional via msix package; zip of build/windows/x64/runner/Release is the lightweight path.
